positioning: For small US recruiting agencies that lose time on call notes, this assistant turns intake calls into structured candidate notes and ATS follow-up actions.
differentiation: Recruiting-specific extraction plus structured ATS follow-up actions, instead of a raw transcript or generic summary.
target_segments: Small US recruiting agencies with 5 to 50 recruiters
channels: Direct outreach to agency owners in one region
LinkedIn demos of the note-to-ATS workflow
Webinars with a before and after intake call
risks: ATS integration access delays the pilot
Candidate data rules differ by state
Agencies hesitate to share call recordings
assumptions: Agencies will share call recordings with a clear data policy
ATS vendors allow write access through a supported interface

claims.text: Lead with ATS integration and data controls, not model quality alone.
Ten paid pilot agencies within 90 days is an achievable launch goal.
The message leads with hours saved per recruiter each week.
